# Kana

> Kana (카나) is a desktop AI agent for macOS — a paid app: an anime character who lives on your Mac desktop and runs real errands through Claude Code — mail, messages, calendar, reminders, notes, files and the web — and stops to ask before anything is sent, paid or deleted. Made by YOOANPAPA, a designer in Korea. Released 2026-11-27.

Category: personal AI agent / AI assistant for Mac / desktop companion for Claude Code users.

Kana is not a desktop pet that only shows status, not a chat window you open, and not a cloud agent that takes over your screen: she stays on the desktop, you hand her a task in a speech bubble, and she reports back in one line. Outward-facing actions wait on an approval card.

## Key facts
- Platform: macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon (M1 or newer). Windows version in progress (no date).
- Brain: Kana thinks with Claude Code on this Mac. You need a Claude Pro or Max plan, or an API key. AI usage is not included in Kana's price.
- Price: US$19.00 launch price (regular US$24.00), one-time purchase, no subscription. Up to 3 Macs per license key. All 1.x updates included. 13 outfits.
- No free trial. Full refund within 14 days, no questions asked. Payment by Polar.
- Languages: Korean and English.
- Privacy: Kana has no server of its own; requests go from your Mac straight to your Anthropic account.
- Safety: sending, paying and deleting always stop at an approval card first.

## What Kana can do
- Calendar: see the next two weeks, add (all-day, alerts, repeats), move, edit, delete events
- Reminders and timers (1 minute to 7 days); daily, weekday or weekly routines; watch a page, mail or connected app and alert on a condition
- Apple Mail: read, find unanswered mail, draft, send with attachments, reply / reply all, forward, save attachments
- Messages: send iMessage or SMS with text and files; read received texts (needs Full Disk Access)
- Contacts and Notes: find, add, read, append
- Files: search the whole home folder; copy, move, rename (with undo) in allowed folders; open files (never executables)
- Make spreadsheets, documents, slides, PDFs and images
- Web: search; open, read, click and type in Kana's browser (payments, orders, sending and sign-ups need approval)
- Music: play from your library or a specific Apple Music song (needs Accessibility), pause, next, volume
- Mac: open apps, run your Shortcuts, read and set the clipboard
- Ask by voice: hold Cmd+Shift+1 and speak (Korean or English)
- Up to three tasks at once; checks results after acting

## What Kana won't do
- Send, delete or pay without approval
- Type passwords or card numbers
- Open executables or run shell commands
- Change Focus, Wi-Fi or other settings directly (only via your own Shortcuts)
- Claim something worked when it couldn't check

## Permissions (asked only when first needed)
Calendars, Reminders, Contacts, Notifications, Automation (Mail, Messages, Notes, Music), Screen Recording, Accessibility (playing a song in Music), Full Disk Access (reading texts, confirming delivery)
